title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: A.D. White Library
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Study in a three-story Victorian Gothic reading room featuring ornate iron stacks and quiet carrels. This space is designated for silent study only.
cards.short_summary: A historic, multi-tiered silent reading room located within Uris Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The A.D. White Library is a historic interior in Uris Library designated as a silent study space.
cards.source_title: Spaces in Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard Uris Library hours; accessible to all Cornell students.

cards.title: Uris Library Cocktail Lounge
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Access this 24/7 study space featuring panoramic views of Libe Slope. Use your Cornell ID for entry after standard building hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study lounge with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Libe Slope.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cocktail Lounge in Uris Library is available for quiet and group study 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with a Cornell ID.
cards.source_title: Spaces in Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; Cornell ID card required for access after building hours.

cards.title: Mui Ho Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Rand Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the suspended stacks and open-concept reading rooms in this rehabilitated industrial space. The top two floors offer voluminous natural light.
cards.short_summary: A modern library in Rand Hall featuring four levels of suspended book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mui Ho Fine Arts Library occupies the top two floors of Rand Hall and provides voluminous reading and study space.
cards.source_title: New Mui Ho Fine Arts Library inspires design - Cornell Chronicle
cards.access_notes: Open to the Cornell community during posted library hours.

cards.title: Clark Physical Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Clark Hall
cards.notes: Find quiet cubicles and 24/7 study access on the second floor of Clark Hall. The space is located directly above the Clark Atrium.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study area located in Room 290 of Clark Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Clark Hall Library Study Space is available 24/7 on the second floor of Clark Hall in room 290.
cards.source_title: Study Space - Clark Physical Sciences Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Study space is open 24/7 whenever Clark Hall is open.

cards.title: Bissett Collaborative Space
cards.subtitle: Mann Library
cards.notes: Use this first-floor area for group work and collaborative projects. It features flexible seating and proximity to the library's main services.
cards.short_summary: A designated collaborative study area on the first floor of Mann Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bissett Collaborative Space is a featured study area in Mann Library suitable for group work.
cards.source_title: Find a Space - Mann Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Open during Mann Library hours; some sections are reservable.

cards.title: Management Library
cards.subtitle: Sage Hall
cards.notes: Study in the heart of Central Campus with a variety of seating from high bar-style chairs to individual desks with lamps and outlets.
cards.short_summary: A cozy library space located within the historic Sage Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Management Library in Sage Hall offers a variety of seating options including desks with lamps and outlets.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Study Spots on Campus | Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Public hours are M-F 7am-8pm; after-hours access restricted to Johnson School students.

cards.title: Kroch Asia Library
cards.subtitle: Olin Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for a secluded environment. This underground space is known for its quiet atmosphere and individual study carrels.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, subterranean study space located beneath Olin Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kroch Asia Library offers open study spaces and is noted for its quiet environment on the lower levels.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Olin & Uris Libraries - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: Accessible through Olin Library during standard operating hours.

cards.title: Browsing Library
cards.subtitle: Willard Straight Hall
cards.notes: Relax in the 'living room' of campus. This comfortable lounge on the 4th floor is suitable for casual studying and socializing.
cards.short_summary: A casual study lounge located on the 4th floor of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Browsing Library (room 404) in Willard Straight Hall is a comfortable place to study and socialize.
cards.source_title: Willard Straight Hall Student Union - Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. during the academic semester.

cards.title: Klarman Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Klarman Hall
cards.notes: Study in a bright, light-filled atrium that connects to Goldwin Smith Hall. The space includes the Temple of Zeus cafe for nearby refreshments.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium serving as a central meeting and study hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Klarman Hall features a light-filled atrium that serves as a meeting place for faculty and students.
cards.source_title: Temple of Zeus - College of Arts & Sciences, Cornell
cards.access_notes: The building is generally open to the public during daytime hours.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Hall
cards.notes: Enjoy a traditional library setting with revolving chairs and ample natural light. This space is typically quieter than the main central libraries.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library in Lincoln Hall specializing in music and dance collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library in Lincoln Hall is a traditional library setting with quiet study areas and natural light.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Study Spots on Campus | Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Open during posted Music Library hours.
